# Design downloads

[Project overview](../README.md) · [Documentation](../docs/README.md) · [Local design review](http://localhost:8765/site/)

Reviewable electrical packages, printable housing parts and source-bound validation evidence.

![Assembled product](../preview/2port-assembled.png)

## Select your package

| Deliverable | Start here | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| Two-port electronics | [2-port files](2port/README.md) | Native exports, fabrication ZIP, BOM/CPL and reports |
| Four-port electronics | [4-port files](4port/README.md) | Reserved-channel engineering variant |
| Printed housing | Matching `2port_` or `4port_` base/lid | STL, 3MF and STEP; add one common ribbon clamp |
| Fit coupons | [Fastener](fastener_coupon.stl) · [DE9 opening](port_coupon.stl) | Print before committing to a full housing |
| Hardware | [Enclosure BOM](enclosure-bom.csv) | Inserts, screws, silicone pads and mating references |
| Browser assembly | [Viewer data](view/README.md) | Shared cad-agent scenes and downloadable meshes |

Print only the matching base/lid pair plus `ribbon_clamp`. STL and 3MF use print orientation; STEP uses assembly coordinates. `asm_*` files are assembly references, not a print list.

Follow the [assembly guide](../ASSEMBLY.md) and [manufacturing guide](../docs/manufacturing.md). These A1 files are engineering review artifacts; supplier DFM and physical qualification remain open.
